# Working things out, visually

I explore mathematics, machine learning and scientific inference through visual explanations and interactive experiments.

After 12 years in asset management, I stepped away to study Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Science. I am now preparing to begin a PhD and continuing to learn how mathematical and computational tools can help us understand complex systems. 

This website is where I work through ideas in public. Some pieces explain concepts that I have found useful, while others explore questions I am still trying to understand.

[Explore the visual essays](essays.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}

## Current direction

My current interests include scientific machine learning. More broadly, I am interested in what models can learn from data, what remains unidentifiable, and how visualisation can help make those limitations easier to see.

I am more interested in developing better questions than presenting polished answers.
